title: Celestial Colosseum Vision
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring the Roman Colosseum in a grassy field under a swirling cosmic sky. Four ethereal women with colorful flowing hair emerge from clouds surrounding a glowing green and blue mandala, while a fiery comet streaks across the sky and dark fantastical creatures appear near the ancient ruins.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of the Roman Colosseum standing in a green field under a swirling cosmic night sky with stars and nebulae. Four beautiful women with blue, purple, and dark hair emerge from clouds in the upper portion, symmetrically arranged around a glowing green and blue geometric mandala. A bright yellow comet streaks across the sky, with smaller birds flying nearby. Dark fantastical creatures and serpentine forms appear in the foreground and around the ruins, blending ancient architecture with cosmic and mystical elements.
